name: hash_tensor
description: Representative ATen signature: aten::hash_tensor(Tensor self, int[1] dim=[], *, bool keepdim=False, int mode=0) -> Tensor. XOR-reduces the widened 64-bit bit representations over the selected dimensions; an empty dimension list reduces all dimensions. The output is a non-differentiable uint64 tensor, mode is 0, and the operation neither mutates nor aliases self.
